description.en: A single unit of shared resources within a cluster, comprised of one or more containers
description.zh: A single unit of shared resources within a cluster, comprised of one or more containers

description.en: A standard unit of virtualized software that packages up code and all its dependencies so the application runs quickly and reliably from one computing environment to another
description.zh: A standard unit of virtualized software that packages up code and all its dependencies so the application runs quickly and reliably from one computing environment to another

description.en: A profile representing a user, device, service, or application used to authenticate and access resources
description.zh: A profile representing a user, device, service, or application used to authenticate and access resources

description.en: A Windows OS hierarchical database that stores much of the information and settings for software programs, hardware devices, user preferences, and operating-system configurations
description.zh: A Windows OS hierarchical database that stores much of the information and settings for software programs, hardware devices, user preferences, and operating-system configurations

description.en: A file or stream containing a list of commands, allowing them to be launched in sequence
description.zh: A file or stream containing a list of commands, allowing them to be launched in sequence

description.en: A single file used to deploy a virtual machine/bootable disk into an on-premise or third-party cloud environment
description.zh: A single file used to deploy a virtual machine/bootable disk into an on-premise or third-party cloud environment

description.en: Credential material, such as session cookies or tokens, used to authenticate to web applications and services
description.zh: Credential material, such as session cookies or tokens, used to authenticate to web applications and services

description.en: Mechanisms that allow inter-process communication locally or over the network. A named pipe is usually found as a file and processes attach to it
description.zh: Mechanisms that allow inter-process communication locally or over the network. A named pipe is usually found as a file and processes attach to it

description.en: A digital document, which highlights information such as the owner's identity, used to instill trust in public keys used while encrypting network communications
description.zh: A digital document, which highlights information such as the owner's identity, used to instill trust in public keys used while encrypting network communications

description.en: The infrastructure for management data and operations that enables local and remote management of Windows personal computers and servers
description.zh: The infrastructure for management data and operations that enables local and remote management of Windows personal computers and servers

description.en: Data object storage infrastructure hosted on-premise or by third-party providers, made available to users through network connections and/or APIs
description.zh: Data object storage infrastructure hosted on-premise or by third-party providers, made available to users through network connections and/or APIs

description.en: Information obtained (commonly via active network traffic probes or web crawling) regarding various types of resources and servers connected to the public Internet
description.zh: Information obtained (commonly via active network traffic probes or web crawling) regarding various types of resources and servers connected to the public Internet

description.en: A malicious online profile representing a user commonly used by adversaries to social engineer or otherwise target victims
description.zh: A malicious online profile representing a user commonly used by adversaries to social engineer or otherwise target victims

description.en: A collection of multiple user accounts that share the same access rights to the computer and/or network resources and have common security rights
description.zh: A collection of multiple user accounts that share the same access rights to the computer and/or network resources and have common security rights

description.en: Events collected by third-party services such as mail servers, web applications, or other appliances (not by the native OS or platform)
description.zh: Events collected by third-party services such as mail servers, web applications, or other appliances (not by the native OS or platform)

description.en: Logon occurring on a system or resource (local, domain, or cloud) to which a user/device is gaining access after successful authentication and authorization
description.zh: Logon occurring on a system or resource (local, domain, or cloud) to which a user/device is gaining access after successful authentication and authorization

description.en: A virtual server environment which runs workloads, hosted on-premise or by third-party cloud providers
description.zh: A virtual server environment which runs workloads, hosted on-premise or by third-party cloud providers

description.en: Information from host telemetry providing insights about system status, errors, or other notable functional activity
description.zh: Information from host telemetry providing insights about system status, errors, or other notable functional activity

description.en: A computer resource object, managed by the I/O system, for storing data (such as images, text, videos, computer programs, or any wide variety of other media).
description.zh: A computer resource object, managed by the I/O system, for storing data (such as images, text, videos, computer programs, or any wide variety of other media).

description.en: A non-volatile data storage device (hard drive, floppy disk, USB flash drive) with at least one formatted partition, typically mounted to the file system and/or assigned a drive letter
description.zh: A non-volatile data storage device (hard drive, floppy disk, USB flash drive) with at least one formatted partition, typically mounted to the file system and/or assigned a drive letter

description.en: A point-in-time copy of cloud volumes (files, settings, etc.) that can be created and/or deployed in cloud environments
description.zh: A point-in-time copy of cloud volumes (files, settings, etc.) that can be created and/or deployed in cloud environments

description.en: A directive given to a computer program, acting as an interpreter of some kind, in order to perform a specific task
description.zh: A directive given to a computer program, acting as an interpreter of some kind, in order to perform a specific task

description.en: A computer program, at the core of a computer OS, that resides in memory and facilitates interactions between hardware and software components
description.zh: A computer program, at the core of a computer OS, that resides in memory and facilitates interactions between hardware and software components

description.en: A computer program that operates or controls a particular type of device that is attached to a computer. Provides a software interface to hardware devices, enabling operating systems and other computer programs to access hardware functions without needing to know precise details about the hardware being used
description.zh: A computer program that operates or controls a particular type of device that is attached to a computer. Provides a software interface to hardware devices, enabling operating systems and other computer programs to access hardware functions without needing to know precise details about the hardware being used

description.en: Block object storage hosted on-premise or by third-party providers, typically made available to resources as virtualized hard drives
description.zh: Block object storage hosted on-premise or by third-party providers, typically made available to resources as virtualized hard drives

description.en: Infrastructure, platforms, or software that are hosted on-premise or by third-party providers, made available to users through network connections and/or APIs
description.zh: Infrastructure, platforms, or software that are hosted on-premise or by third-party providers, made available to users through network connections and/or APIs

description.en: Information obtained (via shared or submitted samples) regarding malicious software (droppers, backdoors, etc.) used by adversaries
description.zh: Information obtained (via shared or submitted samples) regarding malicious software (droppers, backdoors, etc.) used by adversaries

description.en: A storage resource (typically a folder or drive) made available from one host to others using network protocols, such as Server Message Block (SMB) or Network File System (NFS)
description.zh: A storage resource (typically a folder or drive) made available from one host to others using network protocols, such as Server Message Block (SMB) or Network File System (NFS)

description.en: Data transmitted across a network (ex: Web, DNS, Mail, File, etc.), that is either summarized (ex: Netflow) and/or captured as raw data in an analyzable format (ex: PCAP)
description.zh: Data transmitted across a network (ex: Web, DNS, Mail, File, etc.), that is either summarized (ex: Netflow) and/or captured as raw data in an analyzable format (ex: PCAP)

description.en: A set of containerized computing resources that are managed together but have separate nodes to execute various tasks and/or applications
description.zh: A set of containerized computing resources that are managed together but have separate nodes to execute various tasks and/or applications

description.en: Automated tasks that can be executed at a specific time or on a recurring schedule running in the background (ex: Cron daemon, task scheduler, BITS)
description.zh: Automated tasks that can be executed at a specific time or on a recurring schedule running in the background (ex: Cron daemon, task scheduler, BITS)

description.en: Computer software that provides low-level control for the hardware and device(s) of a host, such as BIOS or UEFI/EFI
description.zh: Computer software that provides low-level control for the hardware and device(s) of a host, such as BIOS or UEFI/EFI

description.en: A database and set of services that allows administrators to manage permissions, access to network resources, and stored data objects (user, group, application, or devices)
description.zh: A database and set of services that allows administrators to manage permissions, access to network resources, and stored data objects (user, group, application, or devices)

description.en: A computer process that is configured to execute continuously in the background and perform system tasks, in some cases before any user has logged in
description.zh: A computer process that is configured to execute continuously in the background and perform system tasks, in some cases before any user has logged in

description.en: Information obtained (commonly through registration or activity logs) regarding one or more IP addresses registered with human readable names (ex: mitre.org)
description.zh: Information obtained (commonly through registration or activity logs) regarding one or more IP addresses registered with human readable names (ex: mitre.org)

description.en: Instances of computer programs that are being executed by at least one thread. Processes have memory space for process executables, loaded modules (DLLs or shared libraries), and allocated memory regions containing everything from user input to application-specific data structures
description.zh: Instances of computer programs that are being executed by at least one thread. Processes have memory space for process executables, loaded modules (DLLs or shared libraries), and allocated memory regions containing everything from user input to application-specific data structures

description.en: A network security system, running locally on an endpoint or remotely as a service (ex: cloud environment), that monitors and controls incoming/outgoing network traffic based on predefined rules
description.zh: A network security system, running locally on an endpoint or remotely as a service (ex: cloud environment), that monitors and controls incoming/outgoing network traffic based on predefined rules

description.en: Executable files consisting of one or more shared classes and interfaces, such as portable executable (PE) format binaries/dynamic link libraries (DLL), executable and linkable format (ELF) binaries/shared libraries, and Mach-O format binaries/shared libraries
description.zh: Executable files consisting of one or more shared classes and interfaces, such as portable executable (PE) format binaries/dynamic link libraries (DLL), executable and linkable format (ELF) binaries/shared libraries, and Mach-O format binaries/shared libraries
